subject: geom_bin2d or stat_bin2d with red color

messages.author: e71d155e2fa6db85
messages.subject: geom_bin2d or stat_bin2d with red color
parts:
Dear All,

I am struggling with geom_bin2d that can produce a hot red color in overlapping scatter plot area such as the one below. I saw that in previous version of ggplot2, but with new version ggplot2 I can not see it, instead it is bright blue color in overlapping scatter plot area. How to change the color ? Thanks.

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: geom_bin2d or stat_bin2d with red color
parts:
In the future please give a reproducible example. Basically, though, you want to change the fill scale. For example:

library(ggplot2)
d <- data.frame(x=rnorm(10000),y=rnorm(10000)) 
p <- ggplot(d,aes(x,y))+geom_hex()
print(p)
print(p + scale_fill_continuous(low="blue",high="red"))

Ben
